SELECT cr.chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, b.name AS mateKey, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(b.display_name), ''), b.name) AS mateName, cr.title, cr.last_message AS lastMessage, DATE_FORMAT(cr.last_message_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS lastMessageAt, cr.status FROM CHAT_ROOM cr INNER JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON e.exclusive_id = cr.exclusive_id INNER JOIN BOT b ON b.bot_id = e.bot_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND cr.status NOT IN ('DELETED', 'ARCHIVED') ORDER BY COALESCE(cr.last_message_at, cr.created_at) DESC

SELECT cr.chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, b.name AS mateKey, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(b.display_name), ''), b.name) AS mateName, cr.title, cr.last_message AS lastMessage, DATE_FORMAT(cr.last_message_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS lastMessageAt, cr.status FROM CHAT_ROOM cr INNER JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON e.exclusive_id = cr.exclusive_id INNER JOIN BOT b ON b.bot_id = e.bot_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND cr.status = 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY COALESCE(cr.last_message_at, cr.created_at) DESC

SELECT message_id AS messageId, chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, content, sender_type AS senderType, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM MESSAGE WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM cr INNER JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON e.exclusive_id = cr.exclusive_id WHERE cr.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND e.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT e.exclusive_id AS exclusiveId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(b.display_name), ''), b.name) AS botName, b.name AS botKey, u.nickname AS userNickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM cr2 JOIN EXCLUSIVE e2 ON cr2.exclusive_id = e2.exclusive_id WHERE e2.user_id = u.user_id AND e2.bot_id = b.bot_id AND cr2.status != 'DELETED' ) AS chatCount FROM CHAT_ROOM cr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON cr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id JOIN BOT b ON e.bot_id = b.bot_id JOIN USER u ON e.user_id = u.user_id WHERE cr.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId}
